Expression of Concern.note: Publisher term; keep English and capitalise it as 'Expression of Concern' everywhere, including running text (plural 'Expressions of Concern').

FORRT Replication Database.note: Name of the data source; keep English.

Meta Report.note: ORE's summary report for a page.

pill.note: The small labels ORE adds next to papers. Use 'Markierung' consistently.

reference.note: An entry in a paper's reference list; 'references' (section) → 'Literaturverzeichnis'.

Registered Report.note: Publication format; keep English, plural 'Registered Reports'.

retraction.note: Keep the English noun (plural 'Retractions'); 'Retraction Notice' stays English too. For the state of a paper, 'zurückgezogen' is fine ('Dieser Artikel wurde zurückgezogen'). Never 'Zurückziehung'.

snooze.note: Temporarily turn ORE off on a site: 'Snooze on this site' → 'Auf dieser Website pausieren'.

tour.note: The guided tour of ORE's pills on the current page: 'Tour this page' → 'Seite erkunden' or 'Tour starten'; never 'Seitentour'.
